literal: Even by giving, to secure is necessary surely, of him who, staying close, does improper things, the enmity.
translation: One must surely resolve, even by making concessions, the enmity of a person who stays close but performs improper deeds.
modern: நெருங்கி இருந்து தகுதியற்ற செயல்களைச் செய்பவனுடைய பகையை, ஏதேனும் கொடுத்தாவது தீர்த்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on how to handle the hostility of an untrustworthy person who is physically close but acts improperly. Such a person, being nearby, can cause immense harm through their unfit actions. Therefore, the poet emphasizes that one must surely neutralize or buy off their enmity, even if it requires giving away wealth or making concessions. Resolving this threat immediately is crucial because an enemy within close proximity is highly dangerous.
